newsitem.title: USA: TVA Browns Ferry Ala. nuke fluctuates power output.
newsitem.headline: TVA Browns Ferry Ala. nuke fluctuates power output.

text.p: Tennesee Valley Authority's (TVA) 1,065 megawatt nuclear power unit 3 will fluctuate power output over the next several days as it returns from an outage which began September 4, a company spokesman said.

The Decatur, Ala., unit was holding at 98 percent of capacity, but was expected to reduce power early Friday for a rod reorganization, and then increase power over the following several days towards full output, spokesman Terry Johnson said Thursday.
The unit was taken off line last Wednesday for maintenance, and resumed limited production early this week.
